ticket.title: derive reserve names and descriptions from a Cargo workspace so a mono repo needs no parallel list
ticket.description:
Split out of GB-364, whose remaining acceptance criterion asked that names and descriptions be derivable from a Cargo workspace so a mono repository needs no parallel list. The identity defect in that ticket is fixed (a1549d1): homepage, license and repository now come from flags or the caller origin remote and never default. What is left is not a defect but a convenience for exactly the caller that filed it - aerofoil, whose AF-22 wants to replace a 200-line shell script and would rather not repeat its crate list on the command line.

Wanted: either `outfeed reserve scaffold --from-workspace [path]`, which reads the root Cargo.toml members, takes each package name, and derives the description from that package description, adding names positionally alongside it; or the same derivation in `reserve check` so a caller validates what the workspace holds without naming anything. One of those, not both, and the choice needs a decision about which verb owns reading somebody else Cargo.toml - scaffolding reads one file per name today and has no workspace awareness at all.

Not attempted with GB-364 because a half-built name derivation would scaffold a set nobody asked for, which is worse than making the caller type the names.

Acceptance: a workspace with three members scaffolds three placeholders and no list is passed; a name passed explicitly alongside --from-workspace is scaffolded too rather than ignored; and a workspace file that cannot be parsed is an error naming the path rather than a silent empty list.
